data.one_liner: Dio-based networking client for Flutter with built-in token refresh management.
data.what_it_does: Provides a base ApiClient class built on top of Dio to structure API requests, handle responses, map JSON data using isolates, and manage authentication tokens securely.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application that requires structured REST API integration.
You need built-in handling for authorization tokens and automatic refresh flows.
avoid_when: You prefer using pure Dio without extra wrappers.
You are working with GraphQL or WebSockets rather than a standard REST API backend.
strengths: Built-in authentication token management and storage
Background isolate execution for response mappers
Built on top of the popular Dio package
weaknesses: Requires writing custom response mappers and API client classes
Tied closely to Dash-Kit patterns and conventions
data.setup_notes: Requires creating an ApiClient subclass, setting up an ApiEnvironment, and configuring Dio instances.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using the raw Dio HTTP client without additional Dash-Kit abstractions and token management wrappers.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a simpler, built-in low-level HTTP client rather than a feature-rich networking stack.
